<style>
html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; }
/* ===================================================================
   PHYSIQUE X  |  stylesheet
   Everything scoped to #px-page so nothing leaks into the theme.
   =================================================================== */

#px-page {
  /* Brand */
  --px-purple: #644DE3;
  --px-purple-dark: #4A36B8;
  --px-purple-soft: #DED7FB;
  --px-purple-pale: #F3F0FE;
  --px-ink: #111111;
  --px-ink-2: #1A1824;
  --px-white: #FFFFFF;
  --px-grey-pale: #F5F5F8;
  --px-line: #E7E5F0;
  --px-muted: #6B6880;

  --px-shell: 1240px;
  --px-r-lg: 28px;
  --px-r-md: 20px;

  position: relative;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  background: var(--px-white);
  color: var(--px-ink);
  font-family: 'Montserrat', system-ui, sans-serif;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

#px-page *,
#px-page *::before,
#px-page *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

#px-page img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }

/* Every bitmap is carried as a background so it is stored once, however
   many places use it. These keep the box the right shape without one. */
#px-page img[class*="px-i-"] {
  background-size: cover;
  background-position: center;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
}
#px-page .px-nav-logo img,
#px-page .px-proof-mark img,
#px-page .px-foot-brand img { aspect-ratio: 119 / 120; width: auto; }
#px-page .px-arc-phone img,
#px-page .px-phone-cluster img,
#px-page .px-inside-phone img,
#px-page .px-hero-phone img { aspect-ratio: 440 / 956; height: auto; }
#px-page .px-inside-phone img { width: 100%; }
#px-page .px-hero-phone img { width: 100%; }
#px-page .px-transforms img { aspect-ratio: 1400 / 693; height: auto; }

#px-page .px-shell {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: var(--px-shell);
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding-inline: 32px;
}

/* ─── Type scale ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */

#px-page .px-label {
  display: block;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--px-muted);
  margin-bottom: 1.1rem;
}

#px-page .px-h1,
#px-page .px-h2,
#px-page .px-h3 {
  font-family: 'Oswald', 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  line-height: 0.96;
  letter-spacing: -0.005em;
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* the two-weight headline: light line, then heavy line */
#px-page .px-h1 .thin,
#px-page .px-h2 .thin { font-weight: 300; }

#px-page .px-h1 { font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 5.4vw, 4.6rem); }
#px-page .px-h2 { font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.4rem); }
#px-page .px-h3 { font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 1.6vw, 1.35rem); line-height: 1.15; }

#px-page .px-lead {
  font-size: 1.02rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: #3A3747;
  max-width: 46ch;
}
#px-page .px-note { font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--px-muted); }

/* a heading block with the supporting paragraph set to its right */
#px-page .px-head-split {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(0, 0.85fr);
  gap: 48px;
  align-items: end;
  margin-bottom: 56px;
}
#px-page .px-head-split .px-note { max-width: 42ch; justify-self: end; }

/* ─── Buttons ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

#px-page .px-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 1.05rem 2.2rem;
  border-radius: 100px;
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background .18s, color .18s, border-color .18s, transform .18s;
}
#px-page .px-btn-solid { background: var(--px-purple); color: #fff; }
#px-page .px-btn-solid:hover { background: var(--px-purple-dark); transform: translateY(-2px); }

#px-page .px-btn-ink { background: var(--px-ink); color: #fff; }
#px-page .px-btn-ink:hover { background: #000; transform: translateY(-2px); }

#px-page .px-btn-line { background: transparent; color: var(--px-ink); border-color: var(--px-ink); }
#px-page .px-btn-line:hover { background: var(--px-ink); color: #fff; }

#px-page .px-btn-white { background: #fff; color: var(--px-ink); }
#px-page .px-btn-white:hover { background: var(--px-purple); color: #fff; }

#px-page .px-btn-sm { padding: 0.72rem 1.5rem; font-size: 0.75rem; }

/* ─── Nav ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

#px-page .px-nav-wrap {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 90;
  padding: 18px 32px 0;
}
#px-page .px-nav {
  max-width: var(--px-shell);
  margin: 0 auto;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.88);
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
  border: 1px solid var(--px-line);
  border-radius: 100px;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 34px rgba(26,24,36,0.07);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 24px;
  padding: 10px 10px 10px 26px;
}
#px-page .px-nav-logo { display: flex; align-items: center; text-decoration: none; }
#px-page .px-nav-logo img { height: 34px; width: auto; }
#px-page .px-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 30px; list-style: none; }
#px-page .px-nav-links a {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #37344A;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color .18s;
}
#px-page .px-nav-links a:hover { color: var(--px-purple); }

/* ─── Hero ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

#px-page .px-hero {
  position: relative;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 90% 70% at 85% 10%, #EDE8FE 0%, transparent 60%),
    linear-gradient(170deg, #FBFAFF 0%, #F1EDFE 55%, #FFFFFF 100%);
  padding: 56px 0 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}
#px-page .px-hero-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.05fr);
  gap: 48px;
  align-items: center;
  padding-bottom: 44px;
}
#px-page .px-proof {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid var(--px-line);
  border-radius: 100px;
  padding: 7px 18px 7px 8px;
  margin-bottom: 1.8rem;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(26,24,36,0.06);
}
#px-page .px-proof-mark {
  width: 30px; height: 30px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--px-purple);
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
#px-page .px-proof-mark img { width: 17px; height: auto; }
#px-page .px-proof-text { font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.01em; }
#px-page .px-proof-rule { width: 1px; height: 18px; background: var(--px-line); }
#px-page .px-stars { color: var(--px-purple); letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-size: 0.8rem; }

#px-page .px-hero h1 { margin-bottom: 1.4rem; }
#px-page .px-hero .px-lead { margin-bottom: 2.2rem; }
#px-page .px-hero-btns { display: flex; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 1.1rem; }
#px-page .px-hero-micro {
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--px-muted);
}

/* hero visual: photo panel with two phones overlapping its left edge */
#px-page .px-hero-visual { position: relative; min-height: 560px; }
#px-page .px-hero-photo {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0 0 0 20%;
  border-radius: var(--px-r-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 40px 80px rgba(26,24,36,0.26);
}
#px-page .px-hero-photo img { width: 100%; height: 100%; background-position: 44% 22%; }
#px-page .px-hero-phone {
  position: absolute;
  width: 182px;
  border-radius: 26px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #fff;
  border: 5px solid #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 30px 60px rgba(26,24,36,0.32);
}
#px-page .px-hero-phone-a { left: 0; bottom: 4%; transform: rotate(-7deg); z-index: 2; }
#px-page .px-hero-phone-b { left: 21%; bottom: 23%; transform: rotate(4.5deg); width: 158px; }

/* ─── Marquee band ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

#px-page .px-marquee {
  background: var(--px-purple);
  color: #fff;
  transform: rotate(-1.6deg) scale(1.05);
  margin: 8px 0 76px;
  padding: 18px 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}
#px-page .px-marquee-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 46px;
  align-items: center;
  white-space: nowrap;
  animation: px-slide 34s linear infinite;
  width: max-content;
}
@keyframes px-slide {
  from { transform: translateX(0); }
  to { transform: translateX(-50%); }
}
#px-page .px-marquee-item {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
}
#px-page .px-marquee-item b { font-weight: 700; }
#px-page .px-marquee-star { color: var(--px-purple-soft); }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  #px-page .px-marquee-row { animation: none; }
}

/* ─── Sections ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */

#px-page .px-sec { padding: 96px 0; }
#px-page .px-sec-pale { background: var(--px-purple-pale); }
#px-page .px-sec-grey { background: var(--px-grey-pale); }

/* curved top edge, the way the reference separates its bands */
#px-page .px-curve-top {
  border-top-left-radius: 50% 70px;
  border-top-right-radius: 50% 70px;
}
#px-page .px-curve-bottom {
  border-bottom-left-radius: 50% 70px;
  border-bottom-right-radius: 50% 70px;
}

/* ─── About / stat row ───────────────────────────────────────── */

#px-page .px-about-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 64px;
  align-items: center;
}
#px-page .px-about-copy p + p { margin-top: 1.1rem; }
#px-page .px-statrow {
  display: flex;
  gap: 44px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-top: 2.4rem;
  padding-top: 2rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--px-line);
}
#px-page .px-stat-num {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 1.9rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1;
  color: var(--px-ink);
}
#px-page .px-stat-lbl {
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--px-muted);
  margin-top: 6px;
}

/* phone cluster used beside the about copy */
#px-page .px-phone-cluster { position: relative; min-height: 520px; }
#px-page .px-phone-cluster img {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 26px;
  border: 5px solid #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 26px 54px rgba(26,24,36,0.2);
  width: 220px;
}
#px-page .px-pc-1 { left: 0; top: 40px; transform: rotate(-5deg); }
#px-page .px-pc-2 { left: 29%; top: 0; z-index: 2; }
#px-page .px-pc-3 { right: 0; top: 56px; transform: rotate(5deg); }

/* ─── What's inside: accordion beside a phone ────────────────── */

#px-page .px-inside-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.08fr) minmax(0, 0.92fr);
  gap: 72px;
  align-items: center;
}
#px-page .px-inside-sub { margin-top: 1.1rem; max-width: 44ch; }

#px-page .px-acc { margin-top: 2.2rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--px-line); }
#px-page .px-acc-item { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--px-line); }
#px-page .px-acc-q {
  width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 19px 2px;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 1.12rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.005em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--px-muted);
  transition: color .18s;
}
#px-page .px-acc-q:hover { color: var(--px-ink); }
#px-page .px-acc-item.open .px-acc-q { color: var(--px-ink); }

#px-page .px-acc-ico {
  width: 26px;
  height: 26px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  color: #B5B1C4;
  transition: color .18s;
}
#px-page .px-acc-ico svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
#px-page .px-acc-item.open .px-acc-ico,
#px-page .px-acc-q:hover .px-acc-ico { color: var(--px-purple); }

#px-page .px-acc-q .t { flex: 1; line-height: 1.2; }
#px-page .px-acc-tog {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1;
  color: var(--px-muted);
  transition: transform .22s, color .18s;
}
#px-page .px-acc-item.open .px-acc-tog { transform: rotate(45deg); color: var(--px-ink); }

#px-page .px-acc-a { display: none; padding: 0 2px 22px 42px; }
#px-page .px-acc-item.open .px-acc-a { display: block; }
#px-page .px-acc-a p { font-size: 0.93rem; line-height: 1.7; color: #4A4759; max-width: 52ch; }

#px-page .px-inside-cta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 20px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-top: 2.2rem;
}

/* the phone, its colour blob and the two floating chips */
#px-page .px-inside-visual {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 24px 0;
}
#px-page .px-blob {
  position: absolute;
  width: 430px;
  height: 430px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--px-purple-soft);
  transform: translate(6%, 2%);
  z-index: 0;
}
#px-page .px-inside-phone {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  width: 272px;
  border-radius: 34px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #fff;
  border: 5px solid #fff;
  outline: 2px solid var(--px-purple);
  box-shadow: 0 32px 64px rgba(26,24,36,0.24);
}
#px-page .px-chip {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 2;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  background: #fff;
  border-radius: 100px;
  padding: 11px 18px;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--px-ink);
  white-space: nowrap;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(26,24,36,0.16);
}
#px-page .px-chip-ico {
  width: 17px;
  height: 17px;
  color: var(--px-purple);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
#px-page .px-chip-ico svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
#px-page .px-chip-a { top: 16%; left: -6%; }
#px-page .px-chip-b { bottom: 18%; right: -2%; }

/* ─── App showcase: phones fanned into an arc ────────────────── */

#px-page .px-screens {
  overflow-x: auto;
  scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  scrollbar-width: none;
  padding: 10px 0 30px;
}
#px-page .px-screens::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

#px-page .px-arc {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 20px;
  width: max-content;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding-inline: 32px;
}
#px-page .px-arc-phone {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  margin: 0;
  border-radius: 30px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #fff;
  border: 5px solid #fff;
  outline: 2px solid var(--px-purple);
  outline-offset: -1px;
  box-shadow: 0 26px 54px rgba(26,24,36,0.2);
  scroll-snap-align: center;
}
#px-page .px-arc-phone img { width: 100%; }

/* the fan: outer phones sit lowest, the centre one highest and largest */
#px-page .px-arc-out    { width: 188px; margin-top: 64px; }
#px-page .px-arc-mid    { width: 202px; margin-top: 28px; }
#px-page .px-arc-centre { width: 232px; margin-top: 0; }

#px-page .px-pills {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 11px;
  justify-content: center;
  max-width: 940px;
  margin: 10px auto 0;
}
#px-page .px-pill {
  border: 1.5px solid var(--px-purple-soft);
  border-radius: 100px;
  padding: 11px 22px;
  font-size: 0.87rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  background: #fff;
}
#px-page .px-pill-on { background: var(--px-purple-soft); border-color: var(--px-purple-soft); }

/* ─── Pricing ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

#px-page .px-centred { text-align: center; max-width: 720px; margin: 0 auto 56px; }
#px-page .px-centred .px-note { margin: 1.1rem auto 0; max-width: 54ch; }

#px-page .px-plans {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 22px;
  align-items: start;
}
#px-page .px-plan {
  position: relative;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid var(--px-line);
  border-radius: var(--px-r-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
}
#px-page .px-plan-pop { border: 2px solid var(--px-purple); }
#px-page .px-plan-photo { height: 230px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--px-ink); }
#px-page .px-plan-photo img { width: 100%; height: 100%; }
#px-page .px-plan-body { padding: 26px 28px 30px; }
#px-page .px-plan-pop .px-plan-body { background: var(--px-purple-pale); padding-top: 46px; }
#px-page .px-plan-tag {
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--px-muted);
  margin-bottom: 0.7rem;
}
#px-page .px-plan-price { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
#px-page .px-plan-amt {
  font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif;
  font-size: 3rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1;
}
#px-page .px-plan-per { font-size: 0.86rem; color: var(--px-muted); }
#px-page .px-plan-day {
  display: inline-block;
  background: var(--px-purple-soft);
  border-radius: 100px;
  padding: 5px 14px;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin: 14px 0 20px;
}
#px-page .px-plan .px-btn { width: 100%; }
#px-page .px-plan-note {
  margin-top: 18px;
  padding-top: 16px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--px-line);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--px-muted);
  text-align: center;
  line-height: 1.6;
}
#px-page .px-popular {
  position: absolute;
  top: 14px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: var(--px-purple);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 7px 18px;
  border-radius: 100px;
  z-index: 2;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
#px-page .px-trust {
  display: flex;
  gap: 30px;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-top: 36px;
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  color: var(--px-muted);
}
#px-page .px-trust span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; }
#px-page .px-tick {
  width: 19px; height: 19px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--px-purple);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  line-height: 0;
}
#px-page .px-tick svg {
  width: 10px; height: 10px;
  display: block;
  fill: none;
  stroke: #fff;
  stroke-width: 2;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
}

<script>

(function () {
  "use strict";

  function pxInit() {
    var page = document.getElementById('px-page');
    if (!page) return;

    /* ---- Accordions: the feature list and the FAQ ---- */
    function accordion(container, qSel, itemSel) {
      if (!container) return;
      container.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        var btn = e.target.closest(qSel);
        if (!btn) return;
        var item = btn.parentElement;
        var isOpen = item.classList.contains('open');
        container.querySelectorAll(itemSel).forEach(function (i) {
          i.classList.remove('open');
        });
        if (!isOpen) item.classList.add('open');
      });
    }
    accordion(document.getElementById('pxInside'), '.px-acc-q', '.px-acc-item');
    accordion(document.getElementById('pxFaq'), '.px-faq-q', '.px-faq-item');

    /* ---- Marquee: duplicate the row so the loop has no gap ---- */
    var mq = document.getElementById('pxMarquee');
    if (mq && !mq.dataset.pxCloned) {
      mq.dataset.pxCloned = '1';
      mq.innerHTML = mq.innerHTML + mq.innerHTML;
    }

    /* ---- Smooth scroll for the in-page nav ---- */
    page.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      var a = e.target.closest('a[href^="#"]');
      if (!a) return;
      var id = a.getAttribute('href');
      if (id.length < 2) return;
      var target = document.querySelector(id);
      if (!target) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    });

    /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
       RECOMMENDATION QUIZ

       Three questions, then the membership recommendation. Nothing is
       sent anywhere: the answers only shape the sentence at the top of
       the result panel.
       ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
    var quiz = document.getElementById('pxQuiz');
    if (quiz) {
      var steps = Array.prototype.slice.call(quiz.querySelectorAll('.px-quiz-step'));
      var dots = Array.prototype.slice.call(quiz.querySelectorAll('.px-quiz-dot'));
      var summary = document.getElementById('pxQuizSummary');
      var answers = {};
      var total = steps.filter(function (s) {
        return s.getAttribute('data-step') !== 'result';
      }).length;

      function show(key) {
        steps.forEach(function (s) {
          s.classList.toggle('active', s.getAttribute('data-step') === String(key));
        });
        quiz.classList.toggle('done', key === 'result');
        var n = parseInt(key, 10);
        dots.forEach(function (d, i) {
          d.classList.toggle('on', !isNaN(n) && i < n);
        });
      }

      function sentence() {
        var parts = [];
        if (answers[1]) parts.push('Training to ' + answers[1]);
        if (answers[2]) parts.push(answers[2] + ' a week');
        if (answers[3]) parts.push(answers[3]);
        return parts.join(', ') + '.';
      }

      quiz.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        var opt = e.target.closest('.px-quiz-opt');
        if (opt) {
          var step = opt.closest('.px-quiz-step');
          var num = parseInt(step.getAttribute('data-step'), 10);
          step.querySelectorAll('.px-quiz-opt').forEach(function (o) {
            o.classList.remove('on');
          });
          opt.classList.add('on');
          answers[num] = opt.getAttribute('data-value');
          if (num >= total) {
            if (summary) summary.textContent = sentence();
            show('result');
          } else {
            show(num + 1);
          }
          return;
        }

        var back = e.target.closest('.px-quiz-back');
        if (back) {
          var here = parseInt(back.closest('.px-quiz-step').getAttribute('data-step'), 10);
          show(Math.max(1, here - 1));
          return;
        }

        var restart = e.target.closest('.px-quiz-restart');
        if (restart) {
          answers = {};
          quiz.querySelectorAll('.px-quiz-opt').forEach(function (o) {
            o.classList.remove('on');
          });
          show(1);
        }
      });

      show(1);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", pxInit);
  } else {
    pxInit();
  }
})();

</script>
